answer: Proposal: meter pay to verified work with escrowed clawback. Each task settles from a vault only after a fraud window; any peer submitting an on-chain proof of a failed check claims that escrow, so garbage work earns nothing. Thus k spawned identities—a plume of keys—must still produce k× valid tasks for k× pay; there is no velvet rope of per-head pay, and the fraud window is the ridge between claimed and settled. Assumption: each task ships a cheap objective checker; work needing human judgment stays sybil-prone.
